hooks.command: f=$(python -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$f" | grep -qE '(^|[/\\])(node_modules|dist)[/\\]|(^|[/\\])package-lock\.json$'; then echo "Blocked: $f is build/lock/vendor output. Edit source instead." >&2; exit 2; fi

f=$(python -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" 2>/dev/null && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json 2>&1 || true ;; esac
